text:
Maya (CS): Hey team — kickoff for Zephyr Health onboarding. Quick notes: primary stakeholders listed below, 30/60/90 success signals, enablement plan, and one renewal risk (procurement timeline).

Maya (CS): Stakeholders: Marta (Zephyr - PM), Raj (Zephyr - Eng lead), legal@zephyr (procurement contact).

Marta (Zephyr): Thanks Maya — excited to get started. Our internal deadline for pilot results is ~May 12.

Jamal (AM): Noted. Can you confirm data residency needs? Zephyr mentioned EU-only in intake form.

Marta (Zephyr): Correct — EU region only. Also need SOC2 report.

Priya (Success): I'll own onboarding cadence and weekly check-ins. Proposed: Tue async updates, Fri 30m sync.

Tess (Enablement): I'll schedule two enablement sessions: 1) Platform basics + auth, 2) Eval & success metrics workshop. Prefer week of Apr 1 for session 1.

Arman (SE): I can pair on integration for first two sprints. Need access to a sandbox account and sample dataset (PII removed).

Leo (Platform): We'll provision a dedicated sandbox in eu-west-1; ETA 48h after this thread. tagging infra.

onboard-bot: sandbox-provisioner: request submitted by Leo (Platform) — ticket #SBX-4621

Maya (CS): Success criteria (30/60/90):
- 30d: Auth & sandbox integration completed; 1 canonical prompt flow validated by Zephyr product team.
- 60d: Pilot with 500 weekly queries, latency within SLA, basic cost profiling.
- 90d: Business KPIs measured (reduction in triage time or automation %), decision point for renewal.

Jamal (AM): Flagging renewal risk: procurement has budget approval scheduled for mid-May. If pilot slips we could miss their renewal window. We should add an exec readout by May 5.

Priya (Success): Agreed. I'll prepare a 15-min exec deck template and run a dry-run with Jamal week before.

Marta (Zephyr): Exec readout on May 5 works. Can you include cost burn projections? CFO will ask.

Leo (Platform): Pulling cost estimates from dedicated sandbox + token forecast — will post a brief table in #customer-costs channel.

Arman (SE): Integration blockers we anticipate: API auth (SAML?), data format mismatch, and rate limits for batch jobs. If Zephyr needs SAML, schedule time with Identity team.

Marta (Zephyr): We use SAML. Can SE and Platform coordinate with our IdP team? I'll provide contact.

Tess (Enablement): For feedback capture, we'll run a short 6-question form after each enablement session and a bi-weekly NPS check for pilot users. I'll share the Google Form link here after session 1.

Priya (Success): Also adding a lightweight issue tracker: create a shared Jira board for onboarding bugs/requests and we'll sync on priorities in the weekly call. Marta, can you confirm Zephyr folks who need access?

Marta (Zephyr): Raj and Laila should have access. I'll add them.

Maya (CS): Action items summary:
- Leo: provision sandbox in eu-west-1 (48h) — ticket SBX-4621
- Arman: integration runbook + sample mapping — due in 5 business days
- Tess: schedule session 1 (week of Apr 1) + feedback form
- Priya: weekly cadence invite + exec deck template for May 5
- Jamal: coordinate procurement signals and exec invite
- Marta: share IdP contact and add Raj/Laila to Jira

Marta (Zephyr): Got it. Will start sharing contacts today.

Jamal (AM): I'm adding a wrinkle: if procurement needs an SOC2 artifact we should loop Security early. @Leo can you pull the compliance pack?

Leo (Platform): On it — will DM security and attach SOC2 PDF to the ticket.

Arman (SE): Quick question: what SLA should we validate for latency? Jamal / Marta?

Marta (Zephyr): Ideally p95 under 300ms for single-turn queries. If that's unrealistic we'll capture baseline.

Jamal (AM): We'll aim for 300ms p95 as stretch; Arman to capture baseline in first 2 weeks.

onboard-bot: reminder set: exec-readout-dry-run on 2024-05-01T15:00:00Z

Tess (Enablement): I'll post the invite for session 1 by EOD. Who should receive the session recording?

Marta (Zephyr): Send to project@zephyr and cc Raj, Laila, and myself.

Priya (Success): Closing loop: I'll create the Jira board today and invite all participants. Will also add onboarding checklist with ownership.

Maya (CS): Thanks everyone — feel free to @mention if you need a decision quick. I'll pin this thread in #cs-ops for visibility. :thumbsup:

Marta (Zephyr): Thanks Maya — looking forward to it.

Jamal (AM): I'll follow up with procurement calendar entries.

Leo (Platform): Sandbox ticket updated with SOC2 attachment.

Arman (SE): Starting integration runbook draft now. Will post snippet later.

Tess (Enablement): Feedback form draft: 6 q's + NPS. Posting link after session 1.

Maya (CS): last note — next sync Fri 30m at 10am PT. Invite sent.

Marta (Zephyr): Confirmed. Thanks all!
